# Security policy

Do not open a public Issue for a suspected vulnerability.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting from this repository's Security tab. If the concern involves an account, private deployment, or authorization flow, use [All2CF Support](https://app.all2cf.com/?support=ticket&source=github-security).

Include only the minimum information needed to reproduce the problem. Do not include live credentials or customer data.

LogicMate will acknowledge a valid report, coordinate remediation, and publish an advisory when disclosure is safe.
